title: Digital Piracy, Creative Productivity, and Customer Care Effort: Evidence from the Digital Publishing Industry
eligible_reason: Single event date (termination of V-Disk free storage and search in June 2016); treated group = contracted writers, control = non-contracted writers after propensity-score matching; equation includes lagged feedback controls and interactions.
design_notes: DiD at the writer-book-update level on a Chinese digital publishing platform (969 books). Equation (1): Y_kit = alpha_ki + b1 I_t + b2 Contract_i + b3 I_t x Contract_i + gamma Sales/Tips/Comments_{i,t-1} + interactions + delta C_it + e, with writer-book fixed effects; matched sample from 1:1 nearest-neighbor propensity-score matching. The event indicator I_t switches on at one calendar date for everyone (June 2016), so there is a single adoption date, a time-varying lagged-outcome control set, and matching. Robustness adds month fixed effects and chapter fixed effects.
estimators_reported: matched DiD with writer/book FE (single event)
screener_notes: Not eligible: single adoption date; propensity-score matching; time-varying lagged controls. Data: platform data supplied by a Chinese literature platform plus scraped reader tipping/comment data; no public replication package listed. Screened from article text only.
